# Links, cards and images

A sentence with an [inline link](https://example.com/docs "Docs") stays a link.

[Example Domain](https://example.com "kawruh:card")

[Kawruh on GitHub](https://github.com/rakaadinugroho/kawruh "kawruh:preview")

[](https://example.org/empty "kawruh:card")

[Not a card](https://example.com "kawruh:other")

Text before [a card-looking link](https://example.com "kawruh:card") keeps it inline.

[Title with *stars* and [brackets]](<https://example.com/a (b)> "kawruh:card")

An image ![inline](kawruh-asset://4f1c2a/0aa1.webp "Caption") inside text.
